relation_review.rationale: The campaign text states a broad goal concerning the emerging elder-care law and staffing. The live official registry object is independently identified by matter ID and first-signer ID, and its submitted text proposes an elder-care-law staffing minimum. This is a DOCUMENTED_RELATED_ACTION relation only; the 2017 initiative is outside the campaign's 2011–2015 term and does not establish pledge fulfillment, enactment, implementation, or causation.

bounded_finding.claim_scope: The live source records an initiative authored by Juvonen on a related elder-care staffing policy object; it is not a verified fulfillment of the broad campaign desideratum.
bounded_finding.temporal_scope_note: The campaign text is a broad policy desideratum in a 2011 campaign field (the 2011–2015 term), while the official initiative was submitted in 2017. This packet records only a later related action and does not treat it as a within-term personal-action promise or claim fulfillment.
not_claimed: The initiative was enacted or implemented.
The initiative alone fulfilled every part of the broad campaign statement.
The initiative caused a later policy outcome.
